sources.title: Mercury MEC-D-A-2 Commercial Double Slice Conveyor Toaster - Appliances Direct

mecda2.summary: A compact two-slice-wide commercial conveyor toaster with independently adjustable top and bottom heat and variable belt speed. It can take bread and thicker items such as bagels, and suits cafes, hotel breakfast service and canteens needing steady toast output from a 13 A socket.

highlights.text: Dual-width track for two slices side by side; 300 slices per hour.
Top and bottom heating elements adjustable independently; variable conveyor speed.
Front or rear discharge, eco energy saving mode, cool-touch insulated exterior.

facts.label: Warranty
facts.value: 1 year manufacturer's parts warranty (full parts and labour)

mecda2.notes: Single source read (Appliances Direct); manufacturer page and manual not reachable. Power recorded as 2400 W with unit W, dimensions in cm, as the source gives them.

maxxproet620.summary: The Convotherm Maxx Pro easyTouch 6.20 is a six-plus-one shelf (GN 2/1) combi oven with a 10 inch touchscreen and automatic cleaning. It is sold in electric boiler, electric injection and gas versions; the electric versions draw about 19.5 kW from a three-phase 400V supply. Suits mid-sized restaurant, hotel and canteen kitchens.
